sections.heading: Introduction
sections.core_logic: 能源转型背景→预测方法不足→精度/鲁棒性/效率/多变量四承诺；后三承诺需要不同于点误差的证据。

sections.heading: Literature Review
sections.core_logic: 逐篇回顾并以六维勾叉表建立缺口；不是系统综述或本文实验。

sections.heading: Data Description
sections.core_logic: 定位Canberra Solcast单站数据和两个时间间隔；样本总数、日期及split互相冲突。

sections.heading: Data Preparation
sections.core_logic: 缩放与相关性选择四天气变量，为回归输入。

sections.heading: Data Scaling
sections.core_logic: 全数据极值缩放；Eq1缺减最小值。

sections.heading: Feature Extraction
sections.core_logic: 热图选AT/CO/WV/zenith，未给训练限定或阈值。

sections.heading: An Overview of Bayesian Optimizer
sections.core_logic: 一般贝叶斯搜索/采集函数迭代概念，未明确具体采集函数。

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.core_logic: GPR先验后验和RBF搭建，再用BO调参。

sections.heading: Gaussian Process Regression
sections.core_logic: 带高斯噪声的函数回归/积分预测。

sections.heading: Prior Distribution
sections.core_logic: 均值核函数的高斯先验。

sections.heading: Posterior Distribution
sections.core_logic: 观测更新后验，可给不确定性但实证未校准。

sections.heading: Equations for Mean and Covariance Prediction
sections.core_logic: 预测均值及协方差公式；维度表达有问题。

sections.heading: Radial Basis Function Kernel
sections.core_logic: 距离光滑核假设与流程图连接。

sections.heading: Result and Analysis
sections.core_logic: 七模型×两频率点误差，三强模型时序与分布，解释BO优势。

sections.heading: Performance Evaluation Matrices
sections.core_logic: 六指标定义及表2/3，统计与调参口径不完整。

sections.heading: Comparative Analysis
sections.core_logic: 首100测试样本可视化、跨论文数值比较。

sections.heading: Discussions
sections.core_logic: 机制性解释不构成独立机制实验。

sections.heading: Gaussian Process Regression
sections.core_logic: 核和调参不足解释GPR较弱。

sections.heading: Long Short-Term Memory Networks
sections.core_logic: 时序特征解释LSTM优势，但lookback=1。

sections.heading: GPR with Bayesian Optimizer
sections.core_logic: BO自动搜索和不确定性叙事；无噪声强度/样本规模实验。

sections.heading: Conclusions and Future Work
sections.core_logic: 重述98/90%跨文献优势、鲁棒与适应性；实时数据等留未来。

sections.heading: Declarations
sections.core_logic: 无外部资助，数据称含正文/补充；补充未读。

sections.heading: References
sections.core_logic: 45条引文，本次仅阅读未核验全部引用。
